name: strawtodo
description: Linear-style issue board; each issue gets its own Agent run

scripts.build: npm run build -w @strawtodo/shared && npm run build -w @strawtodo/api && npm run build -w @strawtodo/mcp && npm run build -w @strawtodo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @strawtodo/api && npm run test -w @strawtodo/mcp
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test
